changes.title: Legend circle rules
items: A quest sigil or a relic now works only when put down inside the sleeping legend's circle: its ring glows while you stand in it, and flashes (with a soft thud) if you put one down outside

changes.title: Legend glades
items: Each sleeping legend lies in a small clearing lit by an eerie violet twilight, with glowing motes rising slowly from its floor
Step into a legend's clearing and the rest of the forest goes dark, your own light fades, and the clearing's edge brightens around you

changes.title: Canopy pool
items: Flying over the treetops, the witch's light warms the crowns under her instead of turning them bright green
